profile.summary: Specified Play Equipment Company (SPEC) is a family-owned company that designs and builds playgrounds, parks and recreation spaces. Its clients include cities, schools and design professionals, and it works in California and other states.

review.notes: Cited specplay.com pages confirm the Belmont, CA address, phone, general email, family-owned playground/park design-build business serving schools and cities in multiple states; search results independently list Yosso Group, Inc. as an alternate name of Specified Play Equipment Co. in Belmont, matching the agenda dba and a school site improvements contract. Summary is neutral and supported.
